python3 -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']
items = []
total = 0
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    item = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    if isinstance(amt, (int, float)):
        items.append((cat, item, amt))
        total += amt
for cat, item, amt in items:
    print(f'{cat:<16} {item:<15} {amt:>8}')
print('-'*42)
print(f'Total Expenses (manual sum of C11:C22): {total:,.0f}')
print('Existing Total Expenses formula in C23:', ws['C23'].value)
"
